title: Roadmap editing: park and unpark from the TUI (needs adj 11)

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Parking and unparking an item from the TUI saves a trip to the CLI. It waits on adj 11 (open, key ui.slicer-tui; its recommendation is "both", so ork parks itself). Use the confirm bar (ui.confirm, decided #98) and `slicer park ID` / `slicer unpark ID` (../slicer/docs/commands.md:78). The key cannot be p: S57 gives n and p to row moves (decided #112).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/tui/keys.go` (new park and unpark bindings; not p).
- `internal/tui/model.go:294-303` (confirm handling) and :519-590 (runAction, which holds the exact target).
- `internal/tui/view.go:58-59` (confirm bar text).
- `internal/slicercli/write.go` (new Park and Unpark wrappers, same shape as RelayBegin at :112).
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go` (new write method; name set in the slice).
- `docs/dashboard.md:5` and :219-223 (roadmap editing is after v1); the key list.
Open: the key, and whether park is refused on a running item.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestParkAsksOnTheConfirmBar: the bar shows the exact `slicer park ID` command.
- TestEnterOnConfirmCancelsPark: Enter is No (view.go:59); no slicer call is made.
- TestYesParksAndRefreshesRow: y runs the call and the row shows parked after refresh.
- TestParkFailureShowsErrorCodeVerbatim (docs/dashboard.md:19-20).
- TestUnparkRoundTrip.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): p parks or unparks the selected item; park is refused with a message when the item has an unfinished run.
